subject: Re: MAP Draft — Integration Build Plan & Owners
message_1_subject: Post-call: MAP & Integration build plan (next steps)
message_1_body:
Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for a great discovery call today — appreciate the candid breakdown of Acme's integration needs. Per our discussion, I put together a short MAP draft and an initial integration build plan focused on the SDK/streaming/tool-calling workstreams. The attached DOCX and timeline contain the same content; below is a concise version to confirm owners, dependencies, milestones, and a target close.

High-level MAP milestone (target close):
- Target commercial close: 2026-11-30 (aligned to your Q1 budget cycle)

Integration build plan (milestones, owners, target dates, dependencies):
1) SDK integration (web + mobile) — owner: Dev Patel (Redwood)
   - Scope: language SDKs, auth pattern, sample app, integration tests
   - Target complete: 2026-09-30
   - Dependencies: SDK design doc, test API key & sandbox account from Acme, sample data schema

2) Streaming & low-latency configuration — owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood)
   - Scope: streaming responses, client reconnect, partial-output handling, SLOs (p99 latency)
   - Target complete: 2026-10-15
   - Dependencies: expected request QPS, typical sequence lengths, network topology for prod region

3) Tool calling & structured outputs — owner: Priya Singh (Acme) w/ Redwood support (Marissa + Dev)
   - Scope: define callable tool contracts, output JSON schema, error handling and retry semantics
   - Target complete: 2026-10-30
   - Dependencies: list of tools/endpoints, authentication model (service account), governance on tool privileges

4) End-to-end QA + performance runbook — owner: Dev Patel (Redwood) + Acme QA lead
   - Target complete: 2026-11-15

Open items / asks for Acme:
- Confirm owners above (especially Priya for tool-calling).
- Share sandbox API keys and a sample dataset for the SDK tests by 2026-09-03 to hit the SDK target.
- Confirm desired latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and expected concurrency so Vivek can size streaming config.

Next step: If this looks correct, can we schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) next week with Dev and Vivek? I pasted a couple of proposed windows in the attached timeline.

Attaching: acme_MAP_draft_v1.docx, integration_timeline.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform for production LLMs
message_2_subject: Re: Post-call: MAP & Integration build plan (next steps)
message_2_body:

Two items from my side:

If our engineering team signs off on the timeline by Sept 3, we can commit to the target close date. Let's do the tech deep-dive — Priya and I are available Tues 8/31 10–11am PT or Wed 9/1 1–2pm PT.

Cheers,
Sam

sam.turner@acme.com
message_3_subject: Re: MAP Draft — Integration Build Plan & Owners (answers + next steps)
message_3_body:
Sam / Priya —

Thanks — great questions. Answers inline and a slightly expanded integration plan below. I've also updated the DOCX attachment (v1) to reflect these clarifications and included a proposed calendar invite for the 8/31 10am PT slot; we'll hold the 9/1 slot as backup.

On language support (Dev):
- Dev Patel: the SDK will ship with official JS support and an opinionated Kotlin client for Android. We can also provide sample Kotlin wrappers for iOS teams if needed; estimated additional lift for full native Swift SDK: ~2 dev sprints.

On streaming SLOs (Vivek):
- Vivek Kulkarni: p99 < 300ms for single-token append is achievable in hosted environments in East US for typical small-to-medium payloads, given correct batching config and edge routing. If you require guaranteed SLOs under high sustained concurrency, we can discuss Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity). I'll bring preliminary perf numbers to the deep-dive.

Updated integration build plan (concise):
- SDK integration (owner: Dev Patel, Redwood) — target 2026-09-30
  Responsibilities: SDK API surface, auth examples, sample app, CI tests, publish to npm/maven internal registry.
  Key dependencies: Acme sandbox account, sample data schema, API quota for test runs.

- Streaming & low-latency config (owner: Vivek Kulkarni, Redwood) — target 2026-10-15
  Responsibilities: streaming API integration, client reconnect semantics, latency tuning, monitoring hooks (traces/metrics).
  Key dependencies: agreed SLOs, expected concurrency, PROD region network details.

- Tool calling & structured outputs (owner: Priya Singh, Acme; Redwood support: Marissa, Dev) — target 2026-10-30
  Responsibilities: define callable tool contracts, JSON schema for outputs, error semantics, security model (scoped service account).
  Key dependencies: list of tools, access/credentials model, governance sign-off on tool privileges.

- E2E QA + performance validation (owner: Dev Patel + Acme QA) — target 2026-11-15

Action items I will take this week:
- Send calendar invite for Tue 8/31 10–10:45am PT (technical deep-dive) — invite includes Dev + Vivek + Priya + Sam.
- Share an updated integration_timeline.xlsx with proposed sprint breakdowns (attached).
- Add a short checklist in the DOCX for the sandbox onboarding items we need from Acme.

Sam — please confirm Priya as the tool-calling owner and confirm the 8/31 time. If you want me to add your ops lead to the call, I can do that as well.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
